title: Nice looks storage; looks like a bread box; not as large as it looks
text: Nice looks storage; looks like a bread box; not as large as it looks. This is attractive and useful, but it isn't quite as big as I hoped it would be.  It doesn't really hold that much, due partly to the slanted front.  It looks larger in the pictures than it actually is.  It is made of press-wood and I would have preferred solid wood, but so many things these days are made from press-wood.  The quality seems good.  This looks like a bread box and I guess you could use it for that if the color works well in your kitchen.  It might hold a couple loaves of bread easily, but maybe not much more; possibly 3 or 4 loaves maximum.  You do have to assemble this, but it is not difficult.  I do recommend a power screw driver, as I found it difficult to crank the screws all the way in by hand.  I finally did it all by hand, but it was hard on my wrist.  There are 12 screws that hold it together.  There are also pins included if you want to stack the unit with another like it.  There is an extra screw, an extra stacking pin, an extra screw cover and an extra door pin, in case you should lose any during assembly.  You only need a Phillips-head screwdriver or tip for your power screwdriver.

Retractable door and Dark Brown color provide flexibility to use in many rooms of your house.
description: This Iris stack box with door gives you versatility and flexibility in both function and look. The stack box can be used for storing toys, stuffed animal, books, shoes, home office supplies, and more! The retractable door and Dark Brown color provides flexibility in both storage function and aesthetics. The stackable design increases storage capacity with minimal space requirements by allowing you to stack three boxes vertically. The stack box is easy to assemble and competitively priced to provide the upmost value for your storage needs!
